text.p: Here are the highlights of stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Macedonian public condemned offensive words addressed to President Kiro Gligorov at a celebration of the Macedonian national holiday Ilinden in Drusevo. Citizens of Krusevo demand that opposition VMRO-DPMNE leader Ljupco Georgievski be pronounced as persona non grata in the town.
- The public enterprise for airport services Macedonia said number of passengers fell by 42,000 in the first six months this year over the same period in 1996.
- The government collects only 10 percent of tax each year in the municipalities of Tetovo, Gostivar, Kicevo and Debar.
